title: Soda Firing at Smokestack Pottery
source_quote: Soda Firing at Smokestack Pottery $5-$7.50+ per piece and $10 base fee I regularly fire the soda fired kiln at Smokestack Pottery and it is open to the public to participate and put work in the kiln.
evidence_sentence: The page states Joseph Miranda regularly fires the soda kiln at Smokestack Pottery open to the public.
evidence_quote: I regularly fire the soda fired kiln at Smokestack Pottery and it is open to the public to participate and put work in the kiln.
how_to_join: Contact Joseph Miranda via email or phone to join the soda club email list and gather information on the process.
summary: Joseph Miranda fires the soda kiln regularly at Smokestack Pottery Studio in Fort Collins and welcomes public participation; potters pay per piece to have their work fired.
